Singapore Cancer Centre Sees Significant Rise in Indian Patients

Singapore's Parkway Cancer Centre reported a nearly 20% increase in Indian patients during 2025. A significant majority, between 60-70%, of these patients arrived with advanced or treatment-resistant cancers. Doctors at the centre noted that many Indian patients seek treatment after exhausting options in their home country, which can limit curative possibilities.
